dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: I own a stall here selling drinks, snacks, and stuff like that.

dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: My food is reasonably priced. A popular choice for student meals, welcome parties, and team-building alike!

dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: And I even got the Mahamata among my clients, too! One bought a whole case of wine!
